judgment_calls.decision: The three Yes branches to 'Treat as anaphylaxis 28' become a probable Anaphylaxis rule; no priority evaluation here, since the red box is a pointer and page 28 owns urgency.

judgment_calls.decision: Faint/unwell symptoms count as one body system in the any2 regardless of whether they improved within minutes (not representable).
judgment_calls.alternatives: Leave the faint group out of the any2 (fires less often than the page).

judgment_calls.decision: Pseudoallergic rash probable requires urticaria and recorded absence of every other checked sign, including itching, generalised urticaria and 'generally unwell'.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Allow itching with the rash; the 30-minute monitoring period is not modelled.
